data.gender_notes: Gordy is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Gordy derives from the Old English 'gord' meaning spear or javelin. The name became popular due to the influence of Saint Gordianus, a Roman military commander who was martyred with his brother and father in the 3rd century. The name Gordy carries the meaning “Strong spear” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Gordy usually hope their child will grow to embody strong spear and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gordy total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
data.cultural_impact: The use of the name "Gordy" in the Christian world may be linked to the veneration of Saint Gordianus, who was known for his leadership in the Roman military. The name carries a sense of strength and bravery, fitting for someone who embodies the values of a leader.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Gordy" is also significant spiritually, as it reminds us of the courage and faith of Saint Gordianus and his family. Their willingness to give their lives for their Christian beliefs serves as a powerful reminder of the importance of standing up for what we believe in, even in the face of adversity. Additionally, the name can be seen as a reminder of the power of the spear or javelin, representing the power of God's Word and the importance of using it to defend against the attacks of the enemy.
